column2:
sacrifice(n./v.)犧牲、祭品、獻祭
(無詞性變化)
make sacrifices 做出犧牲
sacrifice A for B 為了B犧牲A
My parents made many sacrifices for our education.
(我爸媽為了我們的教育做了許多犧牲。)
He sacrificed his free time to help his classmates.
(他犧牲自己的空閒時間來幫助同學。)

satellite(n.)衛星、人造衛星
(無詞性變化)
satellite TV 衛星電視
launch a satellite 發射衛星
Taiwan successfully launched a weather satellite into space.
(台灣成功發射了一枚氣象衛星進入太空。)
The moon is the earth's only natural satellite.
(月球是地球唯一的天然衛星。)

satisfaction(n.)滿意、滿足
satisfy(v.)使滿意
satisfactory(adj.)令人滿意的
customer satisfaction 顧客滿意度
job satisfaction 工作滿意度
She felt great satisfaction after finishing the marathon.
(跑完馬拉松後她感到非常滿足。)
The company cares a lot about customer satisfaction.
(這家公司非常重視顧客滿意度。)

scarcely(adv.)幾乎不、僅僅
scarce(adj.)稀少的、缺乏的
scarcely ever 幾乎從不
scarcely... when 一…就
I could scarcely believe my eyes when I saw the result.
(看到結果時，我簡直不敢相信自己的眼睛。)
We had scarcely arrived when it started to rain.
(我們一到達就開始下雨了。)

scenery(n.)風景、景色
scene(n.)場景、景象
scenic(adj.)風景優美的
beautiful scenery 美麗的風景
enjoy the scenery 欣賞風景
Taroko is famous for its beautiful mountain scenery.
(太魯閣以美麗的山景聞名。)
We stopped the car to enjoy the scenery.
(我們停車欣賞風景。)

scold(v./n.)責罵、斥責
scolding(n.)責罵
scold sb. for sth. 因某事責罵某人
get a scolding 挨罵
My mom scolded me for coming home late.
(我媽媽因為我晚回家而罵我。)
He got a scolding from the teacher for sleeping in class.
(他因為上課睡覺被老師罵了一頓。)

scoop(n./v.)勺子、一勺、獨家新聞、舀
(無詞性變化)
a scoop of ice cream 一球冰淇淋
scoop up 舀起、撈起
I'd like two scoops of chocolate ice cream, please.
(請給我兩球巧克力冰淇淋。)
The child scooped up some sand with his hands.
(那孩子用雙手捧起了一些沙子。)

scratch(n./v.)抓痕、擦傷、抓、搔
(無詞性變化)
from scratch 從頭開始
scratch one's head 搔頭、困惑
The cat scratched my arm when I picked it up.
(我抱起貓的時候，牠抓了我的手臂。)
We built the website from scratch.
(我們從零開始建立了這個網站。)

sculpture(n./v.)雕刻、雕塑品、雕塑
sculptor(n.)雕刻家
stone sculpture 石雕
bronze sculpture 銅雕
The park is full of stone sculptures by local artists.
(公園裡到處都是當地藝術家的石雕作品。)
She studied sculpture at an art school in Italy.
(她在義大利的一所藝術學校學雕塑。)

secure(v./adj.)獲得、確保、安全的、穩固的
security(n.)安全、保全
feel secure 感到安心
secure a job 取得一份工作
Children need to feel safe and secure at home.
(孩子們在家需要感到安全和安心。)
She worked hard and finally secured a job at a big company.
(她努力工作，終於在一家大公司謀得職位。)

seize(v.)抓住、奪取、沒收
seizure(n.)奪取、沒收
seize the chance 抓住機會
seize power 奪取政權
You should seize the chance to study abroad.
(你應該抓住出國念書的機會。)
The police seized a large amount of drugs.
(警方查獲了大量毒品。)

settler(n.)移居者、殖民者、開拓者
settle(v.)定居、解決
settlement(n.)定居地、解決
early settlers 早期移民
European settlers 歐洲移民
Early settlers built their homes near the river.
(早期的移民在河邊建造家園。)
The settlers had to survive the cold winter.
(那些開拓者必須熬過寒冷的冬天。)

severe(adj.)嚴重的、嚴厲的、劇烈的
severely(adv.)嚴重地
severity(n.)嚴重性
severe weather 惡劣的天氣
severe pain 劇烈疼痛
The town was hit by a severe storm last night.
(小鎮昨晚遭到強烈暴風雨侵襲。)
He felt a severe pain in his back.
(他感到背部一陣劇痛。)

sew(v.)縫、縫製
sewing(n.)縫紉
sew on 縫上
sewing machine 縫紉機
My grandma sewed a button on my shirt.
(我奶奶幫我把鈕扣縫回襯衫上。)
She learned to sew her own clothes.
(她學會自己縫製衣服。)

shade(n./v.)陰涼處、遮蔽、色調、遮陽
shady(adj.)陰涼的
in the shade 在陰涼處
shades of 各種色調的
Let's sit in the shade of that big tree.
(我們去那棵大樹的樹蔭下坐吧。)
She shaded her eyes from the bright sun.
(她遮住眼睛擋住刺眼的陽光。)

shady(adj.)陰涼的、成蔭的、可疑的
shade(n.)陰涼處
a shady spot 陰涼的地方
shady business 可疑的生意
We found a shady spot under the trees for our picnic.
(我們在樹下找到一個陰涼的地方野餐。)
Don't get involved in his shady business.
(別捲入他那可疑的生意。)

shameful(adj.)可恥的、丟臉的
shame(n.)羞恥
ashamed(adj.)感到羞愧的
shameful behavior 可恥的行為
a shameful secret 不可告人的祕密
Cheating on the test was a shameful thing to do.
(考試作弊是件可恥的事。)
It is shameful to make fun of people in need.
(嘲笑有困難的人是很可恥的。)

shave(v./n.)刮(鬍子)、剃
shaver(n.)電動刮鬍刀
shave off 剃掉
a close shave 千鈞一髮
My father shaves every morning before work.
(我爸爸每天早上上班前都會刮鬍子。)
That was a close shave; the car almost hit us.
(真是千鈞一髮，那輛車差點撞到我們。)

shelter(n./v.)庇護所、避難處、遮蔽
(無詞性變化)
animal shelter 動物收容所
take shelter 避難、躲避
We adopted our dog from an animal shelter.
(我們從動物收容所領養了我們的狗。)
People took shelter in the school during the flood.
(水災期間人們在學校避難。)

shift(n./v.)輪班、轉變、移動、轉移
(無詞性變化)
night shift 夜班
shift attention 轉移注意力
My mother works the night shift at the hospital.
(我媽媽在醫院上夜班。)
There has been a shift in people's attitudes toward pets.
(人們對寵物的態度已經有所轉變。)

sightseeing(n.)觀光、遊覽
sightseer(n.)觀光客
go sightseeing 去觀光
sightseeing tour 觀光行程
We went sightseeing in Tainan last weekend.
(我們上週末去台南觀光。)
The hotel offers a sightseeing tour of the city.
(飯店提供市區觀光行程。)

signature(n./adj.)簽名、招牌的、特色的
sign(v.)簽名
signature dish 招牌菜
collect signatures 收集簽名、連署
This beef noodle soup is the restaurant's signature dish.
(這碗牛肉麵是這家餐廳的招牌菜。)
Please put your signature at the bottom of the form.
(請在表格底部簽名。)

significance(n.)重要性、意義
significant(adj.)重要的、顯著的
of great significance 非常重要的
historical significance 歷史意義
The temple has great historical significance.
(這座廟有重大的歷史意義。)
Few people understood the significance of his discovery.
(很少人理解他這項發現的重要性。)

sincerity(n.)真誠、誠意
sincere(adj.)真誠的
sincerely(adv.)真誠地
in all sincerity 非常真誠地
show sincerity 表現誠意
I could feel the sincerity in his apology.
(我能感受到他道歉中的誠意。)
She spoke with great sincerity about her mistakes.
(她非常真誠地談到自己的錯誤。)

singular(adj./n.)單數的、非凡的、單數
plural(adj./n.)複數的、複數
singular form 單數形
singular noun 單數名詞
The singular form of 'children' is 'child'.
(children的單數形是child。)
Use a singular verb after 'everyone'.
(在everyone後面要用單數動詞。)

site(n./v.)地點、場所、網站、設置
(無詞性變化)
construction site 工地
historic site 古蹟
Workers must wear helmets at the construction site.
(工人在工地必須戴安全帽。)
This old fort is one of Tainan's famous historic sites.
(這座古堡是台南著名的古蹟之一。)

sketch(n./v.)素描、草圖、短劇、畫草圖
sketchy(adj.)粗略的
make a sketch 畫素描
sketch out 概述、草擬
The artist made a quick sketch of the old street.
(這位畫家快速畫了一張老街的素描。)
Let me sketch out my plan for the trip.
(讓我大概說明一下我的旅行計畫。)

skyscraper(n.)摩天大樓
(無詞性變化)
tall skyscraper 高聳的摩天大樓
build a skyscraper 興建摩天大樓
Taipei 101 was once the tallest skyscraper in the world.
(台北101曾經是世界上最高的摩天大樓。)
The city is full of modern skyscrapers.
(這座城市到處都是現代化的摩天大樓。)

slight(adj./n./v.)輕微的、少量的、輕視
slightly(adv.)稍微
a slight change 些微的改變
not in the slightest 一點也不
I have a slight headache today.
(我今天有點頭痛。)
There was a slight change in the schedule.
(行程有些微的變動。)

slogan(n.)標語、口號
(無詞性變化)
advertising slogan 廣告標語
shout slogans 喊口號
The company created a catchy advertising slogan.
(這家公司想出了一句好記的廣告標語。)
The students shouted slogans during the march.
(學生們在遊行中高喊口號。)

socket(n.)插座、(眼)窩、凹槽
(無詞性變化)
electric socket 電源插座
eye socket 眼窩
Don't put your fingers into the electric socket.
(不要把手指伸進電源插座裡。)
Please plug the charger into the socket.
(請把充電器插進插座。)

software(n.)軟體
hardware(n.)硬體
software engineer 軟體工程師
install software 安裝軟體
My cousin works as a software engineer.
(我表哥是一名軟體工程師。)
You need to install new software on your computer.
(你需要在電腦上安裝新的軟體。)

solar(adj.)太陽的、太陽能的
(無詞性變化)
solar energy 太陽能
solar system 太陽系
Many homes now use solar energy to make electricity.
(現在許多家庭使用太陽能發電。)
Jupiter is the largest planet in the solar system.
(木星是太陽系中最大的行星。)

spade(n.)鏟子、(撲克牌)黑桃
(無詞性變化)
call a spade a spade 直言不諱
the ace of spades 黑桃A
He dug a hole in the garden with a spade.
(他用鏟子在花園裡挖了一個洞。)
She always calls a spade a spade.
(她說話總是直言不諱。)

spare(adj./v./n.)空閒的、備用的、撥出、饒恕、備品
(無詞性變化)
spare time 空閒時間
spare tire 備胎
What do you like to do in your spare time?
(你空閒時喜歡做什麼？)
Can you spare a few minutes to help me?
(你能撥出幾分鐘幫我一下嗎？)

spark(n./v.)火花、引發、激起
sparkle(v.)閃耀
spark interest 激起興趣
a spark of hope 一線希望
The teacher's story sparked my interest in history.
(老師的故事激起了我對歷史的興趣。)
A small spark can start a big forest fire.
(一點小火花就能引發一場森林大火。)

spear(n./v.)矛、長槍、用矛刺
(無詞性變化)
throw a spear 擲矛
spear fishing 魚叉捕魚
Ancient hunters used spears to catch animals.
(古代獵人用矛捕捉動物。)
The fisherman speared a fish in the shallow water.
(漁夫在淺水中用魚叉刺中了一條魚。)

species(n.)物種、種類(單複數同形)
(無詞性變化)
endangered species 瀕臨絕種的物種
animal species 動物物種
The Formosan black bear is an endangered species.
(台灣黑熊是瀕臨絕種的物種。)
Scientists discovered a new species of frog in the forest.
(科學家在森林裡發現了一種新的青蛙物種。)

spiritual(adj.)精神的、心靈的、宗教的
spirit(n.)精神、靈魂
spiritual life 精神生活
spiritual leader 精神領袖
Reading poems enriches my spiritual life.
(讀詩豐富了我的精神生活。)
Many people visit the temple for spiritual comfort.
(許多人到廟裡尋求心靈的慰藉。)

splendid(adj.)壯麗的、極好的
splendor(n.)壯麗、輝煌
a splendid view 壯麗的景色
a splendid idea 絕妙的主意
We had a splendid view of the mountains from the hotel.
(我們從飯店可以看到壯麗的山景。)
That's a splendid idea! Let's do it.
(那真是個絕妙的主意！我們就這麼做吧。)

split(v./n.)分開、分攤、劈開、分裂
(無詞性變化)
split the bill 分攤帳單
split up 分手、分開
Let's split the bill after dinner.
(晚餐後我們來分攤帳單吧。)
The teacher split the class into four groups.
(老師把全班分成四組。)

sprinkle(v./n.)灑、撒、少量
sprinkler(n.)灑水器
sprinkle with 撒上…
a sprinkle of 少許…
Sprinkle some sugar on the strawberries.
(在草莓上撒一些糖。)
The gardener sprinkled water on the flowers.
(園丁在花上灑水。)

stab(n./v.)刺、戳、刺傷、嘗試
stabbing(adj.)刺痛的
stab sb. in the back 背後捅刀、背叛
have a stab at 嘗試
The man was stabbed in the arm during the fight.
(那名男子在打鬥中手臂被刺傷。)
I've never cooked before, but I'll have a stab at it.
(我從沒煮過飯，但我會試試看。)

statistic(n.)統計數字
statistics(n.)統計資料、統計學
statistical(adj.)統計的
official statistics 官方統計資料
according to statistics 根據統計
According to statistics, more people are living alone.
(根據統計，獨居的人越來越多。)
My sister majors in statistics at university.
(我姊姊在大學主修統計學。)

status(n.)地位、身分、狀態
(無詞性變化)
social status 社會地位
status symbol 身分地位的象徵
In the past, a car was seen as a status symbol.
(過去汽車被視為身分地位的象徵。)
You can check the status of your order online.
(你可以在網路上查詢訂單的狀態。)

stem(n./v.)莖、梗、源自、阻止
(無詞性變化)
stem from 起源於、由…造成
stem cell 幹細胞
Cut the flower stems before putting them in water.
(把花放進水裡之前先修剪花莖。)
His fear of water stems from a childhood accident.
(他怕水是源自童年的一次意外。)

stereo(n.)立體音響、立體聲
(無詞性變化)
car stereo 汽車音響
in stereo 以立體聲
He turned up the car stereo and sang along.
(他把車上的音響調大聲，跟著一起唱。)
This old song was recorded in stereo.
(這首老歌是用立體聲錄製的。)

stingy(adj.)小氣的、吝嗇的
(無詞性變化)
stingy with 對…小氣
a stingy boss 吝嗇的老闆
Don't be so stingy; buy your friends a drink.
(別那麼小氣，請你朋友喝杯飲料吧。)
Our stingy boss never gives us a bonus.
(我們那個小氣的老闆從不發獎金給我們。)

stocking(n.)長襪
stockings(n.)長襪(複數)
Christmas stocking 聖誕襪
a pair of stockings 一雙長襪
The children hung their Christmas stockings by the fireplace.
(孩子們把聖誕襪掛在壁爐旁。)
She wore a pair of black stockings with her dress.
(她穿洋裝時搭配了一雙黑色長襪。)

strengthen(v.)加強、增強
strength(n.)力量、長處
strong(adj.)強壯的
strengthen muscles 鍛鍊肌肉
strengthen relationships 加強關係
Swimming can strengthen your muscles.
(游泳可以強化你的肌肉。)
The exchange program strengthened the ties between the two schools.
(這個交換計畫加強了兩校之間的關係。)

stripe(n.)條紋、線條
striped(adj.)有條紋的
black and white stripes 黑白條紋
stars and stripes 星條旗
Zebras have black and white stripes.
(斑馬身上有黑白相間的條紋。)
He wore a shirt with blue stripes.
(他穿著一件藍色條紋襯衫。)

strive(v.)努力、奮鬥
strife(n.)衝突
strive for 為…而努力
strive to do 努力做…
We should always strive for excellence.
(我們應該永遠追求卓越。)
She strives to improve her English every day.
(她每天努力提升自己的英文。)

stroke(n./v.)中風、一擊、筆畫、撫摸
(無詞性變化)
a stroke of luck 一次好運
have a stroke 中風
By a stroke of luck, we caught the last train.
(運氣很好，我們趕上了末班火車。)
She gently stroked the cat's back.
(她輕輕撫摸那隻貓的背。)

submarine(n./adj.)潛水艇、海底的
(無詞性變化)
nuclear submarine 核子潛艇
submarine cable 海底電纜
The submarine can stay underwater for months.
(這艘潛水艇可以在水下停留好幾個月。)
A submarine cable carries internet data between countries.
(海底電纜在國家之間傳輸網路資料。)

sue(v.)控告、提告
(無詞性變化)
sue sb. for sth. 因某事控告某人
sue for damages 要求損害賠償
The singer sued the magazine for printing lies.
(那位歌手控告雜誌刊登不實內容。)
He threatened to sue the company for damages.
(他揚言要控告那家公司要求賠償。)

suggestion(n.)建議、暗示
suggest(v.)建議
make a suggestion 提出建議
at one's suggestion 依照某人的建議
Can I make a suggestion about the class trip?
(我可以對班遊提出一個建議嗎？)
At my teacher's suggestion, I joined the debate team.
(依照老師的建議，我參加了辯論社。)

summarize(v.)總結、摘要
summary(n.)摘要
summarize the main points 歸納重點
to summarize 總而言之
Please summarize the story in three sentences.
(請用三句話總結這個故事。)
The teacher summarized the main points at the end of class.
(老師在下課前歸納了重點。)

surgeon(n.)外科醫生
surgery(n.)手術、外科
plastic surgeon 整形外科醫生
heart surgeon 心臟外科醫生
My uncle is a heart surgeon at a big hospital.
(我舅舅是一家大醫院的心臟外科醫生。)
The surgeon spent five hours on the operation.
(外科醫生花了五個小時進行這場手術。)

surgery(n.)手術、外科
surgeon(n.)外科醫生
surgical(adj.)外科的
have surgery 動手術
plastic surgery 整形手術
My grandpa had surgery on his knee last month.
(我爺爺上個月膝蓋動了手術。)
She is recovering well after the surgery.
(她手術後恢復得很好。)

surrender(v./n.)投降、放棄、交出
(無詞性變化)
surrender to 向…投降
surrender a weapon 交出武器
The enemy soldiers finally surrendered.
(敵軍士兵最後投降了。)
The man was told to surrender his weapon to the police.
(那名男子被要求向警方交出武器。)

surroundings(n.)環境、周遭事物
surround(v.)圍繞
surrounding(adj.)周圍的
natural surroundings 自然環境
